text:
jordan (NorthBridge): Hey Redwood team — NorthBridge wants to kick off the joint pilot next Tue. Need a staging tenant, SSO test user, and a rough ops checklist. Also pricing estimate for ~100k tokens/day. Who can own? :wave:
maya: I can own partner ops handoff. Timeline OK for Tue but need confirmation on SSO + tenant provisioning by EOD Fri.
sam: For staging tenant — we can spin one in Dedicated sandbox. Question: do you need GPU-backed model or embeddings-only?
jordan (NorthBridge): We'll be doing chat + embeddings. Latency sensitive for responses under 300ms on average.
sam: Noted. We'll provision a gpu pool and a quantized model variant to hit latency. Will add autoscaling config.
leo: For the ops checklist: 1) Tenant provisioned 2) SSO (SAML) test user + metadata 3) Network egress rules (IP allowlist) 4) Entitlement + quota 5) Telemetry hooks (trace id) 6) Rollback policy. I'll draft a short runbook.
maya: Jordan — can you share the SAML metadata and the SP/IDP contact? Also need billing owner for the token estimate.
jordan (NorthBridge): Sending metadata now, pinging the security contact: sec-contact@northbridge.example (they'll be on the thread when needed). Billing owner is @anna-northbridge (cc).
anita: Quick flag from security: need answers to three enterprise questions before prod: 1) KMS/HSM options for key storage 2) Audit log retention and export 3) Data residency controls. For pilot, a signed NDA + SOC2 snapshot is fine but please confirm HSM requirement.
jordan (NorthBridge): HSM is a must for keys in their environment; they want bring-your-own-key (BYOK). Is that supported on the Private stack?
leo: BYOK supported on Private and Dedicated with KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK). For Hosted we can do a customer-managed key via gateway, but not HSM in host. We'll add a note in runbook.
sam: Network note: they have strict egress rules; we'll need to expose a static outbound IP for callback webhooks. Ops can request static NAT for the sandbox.
maya: Pricing quick answer: for 100k tokens/day at typical mix (prompt: 60%, completion: 40%), rough hosted estimate is $X/day. For Dedicated reserved capacity we'll quote a flat monthly commit — I'll pull numbers and post a formal quote by Fri.
jordan (NorthBridge): Can you also confirm SLOs for pilot (99.5% availability, p95 latency <500ms)?
sam: We can commit to 99.5% for Dedicated sandbox and p95 <500ms expected; I'll include telemetry to verify.
anita: Security questionnaire: Jordan, please attach the partner's completed vendor questionnaire (we'll fill the vendor side). Also we need IP ranges for their devs if they want to test from inside their corp network.
jordan (NorthBridge): Uploaded questionnaire here: https://files.northbridge.example/pilot-security-q1.pdf  Also dev IP range: 198.51.100.0/24.
leo: I'll put together a quick smoke test for the tenant — includes: health endpoint, sample generation (curl example), and trace id propagation. Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"model":"tiny-chat-v1","input":"hi"}'
```

maya: Next actions summary: Maya -> confirm tenant + billing contact (TODAY), Sam -> provision sandbox + static egress (by Fri), Leo -> runbook + smoke tests (Mon), Anita -> complete security checklist and confirm BYOK path (Fri). Jordan -> get NDA signed + confirm partner security contact and upload questionnaire (today).
jordan (NorthBridge): Got it. We'll aim to have NDA signed today. One more ask: can Redwood provide a short enablement session (30m) for their SREs next Wed?
maya: Yes — schedule a 30m deep-dive Wed 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and docs (enablement deck + runbook link).
sec-bot: Security scan scheduled for tenant "northbridge-staging" on 1717774000. Results will post to #eng-security.
leo: Final note — if the partner wants lower latency, we can set up a canary route to a regional capacity pool. We'll discuss during enablement.
maya: Thanks everyone — I'll post the firm quote + provisioning ETA by EOD Fri in this thread. :thumbsup:
